birth.stop: Ascoli Piceno: the birth the register does not settle
birth.date_confidence: the day and the city are firm across every source reached; the year is not. es.wikipedia gives 1846, it.wikipedia's raw wikitext gives AnnoNascita = 1848 and its body says he was born at Ascoli Piceno in 1848, and the Istituto Italiano di Cultura di Córdoba prints 1848-1891 in the same text that bills its 29 January 2016 tribute as his 170th anniversary, a figure only 1846 supports. No civil or baptismal record was consulted. 1846 orders this file and settles nothing. An earlier draft's rival birthplace, Jesi, is dropped: Jesi is the home of his correspondent, not of his family
